entities.summary: Anri Mikhail-ipa Jergenia had been one of the leading politicians of the internationally unrecognised Republic of Abkhazia since it achieved de facto independence from Georgia. From June 2001 to November 2002, he was the republic's Prime Minister, and for a time, Jergenia looked to be the favourite to succeed Abkhazia's first president Vladislav Ardzinba.
